label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common), mid-episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (100% of activations; that conjunction alone has precision 0.21). It never fires at D1 or GO, after a1, or on rare transitions. Within that set the firing rate depends strongly on where the trial falls in the episode: it peaks at trials 40-79 and is silent from trial 80 on, which suggests slow drift in the hidden state. Adding ep_trial 30-79 raises dev F1 to 0.50 (P 0.35, R 0.84). Magnitude is larger when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 69% of the mass but only 45% of the activations; the top quartile is 96% prev_reward==0). It is also larger when the value head is high and the policy logit is only mildly negative (choice between -4.4 and -1.5), i.e. a weak preference for a2. Adding choice > -4.44 gives F1 0.55, but I did not record it because it is a model-internal readout. All variables are observable at D2.
